humanAction: Ran the plugin's runLinterAllFilesInFolder against the scratch folder, which is the same entry point the command "Linter: Lint all files in folder" calls. Every markdown file in the folder was rewritten through vault.modify.
notes: NON-DETERMINISTIC FIELDS: the captured expected/Messy note.md carries created: 2026-09-09T12:19:22+00:00 and modified: 2026-09-09T12:20:01+00:00, written by the linter's YAML timestamp rules from the wall clock and the file's stat. A replay produces different values, so the comparison must normalise those two frontmatter keys before diffing. EDITOR PATH NOT COVERED: the linter's GUI save path runs through a CodeMirror 6 dispatch transaction on the live editor (editor.cm.dispatch), and no headless equivalent of a CM6 transaction exists; this scenario deliberately drives the FILE path (vault.modify) instead, so a passing linter case is not evidence that the editor path works. lintOnFileChange is false in these settings, so the metadataCache "changed" pass does not fire; the rewrite here comes entirely from the folder lint. The command itself is registered with an editorCheckCallback that derives the folder from the live active file, so the capture called runLinterAllFilesInFolder with the scratch folder explicitly rather than letting it resolve a folder in the human's live vault.
